items.title: George "Jug" Jernberg Interview, 1963-08-23
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...is supported by, say, Frankie Quartel, for example. He swears by Lopez.

ctx.x: Salisbury were a singing trio in the Windcliffe Inn, and Ray Lopez was in the band that played for dancing down there. And Ray Lopez's father was the clarinet player. He could play the New Orleans style clarinet fairly well, you know, nothing to brag about. Ray Lopez, yeah. And Charlie Thorpe played piano there for the singers, and Earl, what the heck was his name, Earl Chigrew or some such name as that, played piano with the dance band. And then later on when Benny Fields married Blossom Sealy, Ray Lopez went…
That's how they got... Well, what do you say about Ray Lopez being the best of the early Dixieland trumpet players is supported by, say, Frankie Quartel, for example. He swears by Lopez.
